topic: Generosity
text: Generosity for the sake of Allah is the worship of those who are close [to Allah].

topic: Generosity
text: Generosity without fear or hope of recompense is true generosity.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Verily the people of Paradise constitute all the believers who are easygoing and gentle.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Verily Allah, the Exalted, makes whomever He wishes, from those of his servants who posses sincere intentions and righteous hearts, enter Paradise.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Paradise is the abode of peace.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: If you must be desirous of something, then be desirous of a Paradise, the span of which covers the heavens and the earth.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Paradise is the reward of the obedient.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Paradise is the abode of the pious.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Paradise is the goal of the foremost [in righteousness].

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Paradise is the most excellent goal.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Paradise is the returning place of the victorious.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Paradise is the reward of every righteous believer.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Paradise is attained through keeping away from sins.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Verily you will not enter Paradise until you restrain yourself from misdeeds and stop [committing them]; and deter yourself from sins and desist [from them].

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: If you believe in Allah and abstain from what He has forbidden, He will put you in the Abode of Peace, and if you please Him, He will cover you with [divine] favour.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: The price of Paradise is good deeds.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: The price of Paradise is renunciation of the [pleasures of this] world.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: The chiefs of the people of Paradise are the generous and the pious.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: The chiefs of the people of Paradise are the sincere ones.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: The chiefs of the people of Paradise are the God-fearing and the virtuous.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Seeking Paradise without good deeds is foolishness.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Paradise is not achieved [simply] by wishing for it.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Neither a swindler nor one who put others under obligation, will enter Paradise.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: None will be victorious in attaining Paradise except one whose heart is good and intention sincere.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Every bliss other than Paradise is derisory.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: None will be victorious in attaining Paradise except the one who works hard for it.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: None shall attain Paradise except the one who struggles against his [lower] self.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: One who yearns for Paradise forgets his [worldly] desires.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Paradise is attained through abstaining from sins.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: One who shuns what is forbidden shall attain Paradise.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: How impossible! Allah cannot be cheated of His Paradise, and none can attain what is with Him except by His pleasure.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: The delegation that enters Paradise is constantly showered with blessings.

topic: Paradise and the People of Paradise
text: Those who enter Paradise are in perpetual bliss.

topic: Stinginess and Avarice
text: There is no alienation like avarice.

topic: Stinginess and Avarice
text: There is no magnanimity with avarice.

topic: Stinginess and Avarice
text: There is no evil trait worse than avarice.

topic: Stinginess and Avarice
text: There is no evil trait worse than stinginess

topic: The Believer
text: A believer has a perfect intellect, a pleasing leniency, an inclination towards good deeds and an aversion towards bad deeds.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer has three times: a time for whispering to his Lord, a time for assessing himself (or in another narration: a time for making arrangements for his livelihood) and a time when he freely enjoys himself with what is lawful and pleasant.

topic: The Believer
text: The faith of a believer is not perfected until he deems comfort to be a trial and affliction to be a blessing.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is never found to be envious, malevolent or miserly.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is never anything other than forbearing and merciful.

topic: The Believer
text: It behoves a believer to feel ashamed if the thought of disobedience crosses his mind.

topic: The Believer
text: It behoves a believer to remain obedient and to cover himself with piety and contentment.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is tested with affliction just like the purity of gold and silver is tested with fire.

topic: The Believer
text: There are three signs of a believer: truthfulness, certitude and [having] short hopes.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is never found to be anything but content.

topic: The Believer
text: He who is not concerned about improving his Hereafter is not a believer.

topic: The Believer
text: If I were to strike the nose of a believer to make him hate me he would still not hate me, and if I were to bestow the whole world to a hypocrite to make him love me he would still not love me.

topic: The Believer
text: One who believes is safe.

topic: The Believer
text: One who believes increases his certitude.

topic: The Believer
text: One who believes in Allah seeks [help and] protection from Him.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer has not [truly] believed until he comprehends.

topic: The Believer
text: The example of a believer is like that of citronella, both its taste and its fragrance are pleasant.

topic: The Believer
text: One who purifies his faith is guided.

topic: The Believer
text: The concern of a believer is for his Hereafter, and all his efforts are for his place of [final] return.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is never satiated while his brother is hungry.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer never falls short of forbearance and never gets anxious when faced with difficulty.

topic: The Believer
text: A man does not become a [true] believer until he is no longer concerned about what [food] will end his pangs of hunger and which of his two attires he will wear.

topic: The Believer
text: The cheerfulness of a believer is in his face and his sorrow is in his heart. He has the broadest chest (i.e. has great patience, knowledge and virtue) and is most humble in spirit. He hates high position and dislikes renown. His grief is long, his sorrow is distant, his silence is much and his time is occupied. He is grateful and patient, submerged in his thoughts [about the Hereafter], sparing in his friendship, easy going and of soft temperament. He is firmer than a hard rock but humbler than a slave.

topic: The Believer
text: The beauty of a believer’s face is from the special favour of Allah on him.

topic: The Believer
text: Verily the certitude of a believer is seen in his actions and the doubt of a hypocrite is seen in his actions.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is sagacious and intelligent.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is free from perversion and dissension.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is penitent, repentant and remorseful.

topic: The Believer
text: The nature of a believer is [being] sincere and his trait is suppressing anger.

topic: The Believer
text: The believers are such that their good deeds are expected and people are safe from their evil.

topic: The Believer
text: The fear of a believer is in his heart and his repentance is in his admission.

topic: The Believer
text: Three things are adornments for believers: fear of Allah, truthful speech and returning trusts [to their rightful owners].

topic: The Believer
text: The beauty of a believer is his piety.

topic: The Believer
text: The joy of a believer is in the obedience of his Lord, and his sorrow is due to his sin.

topic: The Believer
text: The integrity of a believer is in his keeping away from what is forbidden and hastening towards virtues.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is easy going, polite, approachable and reliable.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer makes few mistakes and does plenty of work.

topic: The Believer
text: The demeanour of a believer is characterized by moderation and his conduct is upright.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer loathes idle play and likes to work hard.

topic: The Believer
text: When the soul of a believer ascends to the heavens, the angels are amazed and say: It is incredible how he was saved from a place where the best of us2 got corrupted.
flag_note: Contains a stray character/typo '2' within the text.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is sorrowful in his thoughts [about himself], sparing in his friendship.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer has a mild disposition and is easy going.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer does not oppress [anyone] and eschews sin.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is fair to the one who is unfair to him.

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is affectionate, endearing and compassionate.

topic: The Believer
text: Indeed believers are approachable and soft-hearted.

topic: The Believer
text: Believers are indeed virtuous.

topic: The Believer
text: Indeed believers are fearful [of Allah].

topic: The Believer
text: A believer is [gauged] by his actions.

topic: The Believer
text: Believers possess more intelligence [than others]. apprehensive [of the punishment of Allah].
flag_note: Contains a garbled sentence fragment at the end.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: Hopes bring death closer.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One whose aspirations increase, his satisfaction decreases.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One whose hopes lengthen, his actions become worse.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One who is deceived by hope is misled by it.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One who is deceived by aspirations is belied by death.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One who reaches the end of his hopes should expect the arrival of his death.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One who follows his aspirations faces increased hardship.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One who proceeds on the path of his hopes, stumbles upon his death.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One whose aspirations increase, his hardship increases.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One who hopes for that which is not possible, his anticipation becomes long.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One whose hope is [to reach] Allah, shall realize the fulfilment of his hope and aspiration.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: Whoever regards his remaining lifetime to be fleeting, his hopes and aspirations become short.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One who proceeds on the course of his hopes, stumbles upon his death.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One who hopes for anything other than Allah, the Glorified, has given lie to his hopes.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: One who seeks support from his aspirations becomes penniless.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: It is foolishness to depending on [one’s] hope.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: The humiliation of men is in the dashing of hopes.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: May Allah have mercy on the man who shortens his hopes, anticipates death, makes good use of his time and takes with him the provisions of [good] deeds.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: Many an aspiration may lie beneath death.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: Take away from your long hopes and increase your short lifetime, and do not be deceived by your good physical health and yesterday’s wellbeing, for life is short and good health is prone to change.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: The worst poverty is [false] aspiration.

topic: Hopes and Aspiration
text: Lifetimes are wasted between hope and aspiration.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: He who loses the one who was his brother for the sake of Allah, it is as if he has lost the most important organ of his body.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who preserves [that which is entrusted to him] and is loyal will not be deprived of the benefit of brotherhood.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: It is from weak personal judgment to break ties with one’s brothers.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: How numerous are friends during times of prosperity and how few they are during the difficult times!

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: No community has established brotherhood for other than seeking the pleasure of Allah, the Glorified, but that their brotherhood will be counted as a sin against them on the day when the deeds are presented to Allah, the Glorified.
flag_note: The text appears to contain a logical contradiction or translation error regarding the nature of brotherhood for the sake of Allah.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Death of a brother is like having wings clipped and hands cut.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The order of humanity is based on righteous brotherhood and the order of religion is based on unshakable certainty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not sever ties with your brother because of some doubt that you have, and do not abandon him after he has sought [your] pardon.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not neglect the rights of your brother out of confidence in your close relationship with him, for he whose rights you neglect is not your brother.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not take as a brother one who hides your positive traits and exposes your shortcomings.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not seek brotherhood [and friendship] among the uncouth people, rather seek it among the trustworthy and loyal people.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: There is no good in the one who abandons his brother without [him committing] any offence.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: There is no good in the brother who does not enjoin on you what he enjoins on himself.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The brotherhood of the righteous is to be considered beneficial whereas association with the wicked and sinful is to be avoided.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to accept the words of a liar, for he will bring close to you that which is far and take far away from you that which is close.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to drive away your friend in a way that removes all the affection he has for you, and leave some room from your friendship for him so that he may rely on returning back to it.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to alienate the one who has affection for you in such a manner that he opts to distance himself and prefers to separate himself from you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to associate with the one who makes you negligent and deceives you, for he will surely forsake you and destroy you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to associate with the sinners, for verily one who is pleased with the actions of a group is like one of them.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to befriend a wicked person, for he would surely sell his friendship for the most worthless of things.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: It is better and more appropriate to associate with people of wisdom and intelligence.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best habits are honouring one’s companion and assisting one who seeks help.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The noblest of traits is guarding one’s friendship and the best of endeavours is fulfilling one’s promise.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Whoever invites you to the Eternal Abode and assists you to work for it, then he is the true, caring friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The friend in one’s worldly life is like the friend in his faith.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Inquire about the companion [on the journey] before the route.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The true friend will not turn away from his friendship even if he is treated harshly.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Bring yourself to build ties with your brother when he cuts you off, and to be kind and seek closeness [to him] when he turns away from you, and to be near to him when he distances himself from you, and to assume that he has an excuse when he does something wrong to you – to the extent that you are like his servant, and as if he has done some great favor upon you. Beware however, not to do this where it is not befitting or with someone who is not worthy of it.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be sincere in giving your brother advice whether [he finds it] courteous or offensive.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Bring yourself to be polite to your brother when he is harsh to you, and to build ties [with him] when he cuts you off, and to be generous [with him] when he is niggardly, and tolerate what he does and keep relations with him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Choose the new of everything but the oldest one from among your brothers.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Avoid the company of a liar, but if you are forced to be in his company then do not accept his words as true, and do not let him know that you belie him, for he will readily turn away from your friendship rather than abandoning his habit [of lying].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Spare no effort in showing affection to your friend, but do not put your entire trust in him; give him all your support, but do not disclose all your secrets to him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The loss of one’s brothers weakens one’s fortitude.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: He whom you need to indulge is not your [true] brother.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: He who forces his companion to argue with him is not a comrade with praiseworthy traits.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: He who makes it necessary for you to get a judge to adjudicate between yourself and him is not your brother.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The embellishment of brotherhood is good companionship and [giving] support despite [financial] difficulty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Good brotherhood increases reward and beautifies praise.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of brothers are the least hypocritical in giving good advice.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of brothers is the one who makes it unnecessary for his brother to seek from anyone other than him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of your brothers is the one who is stern with you regarding obedience to Allah.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of your brothers is the one who supports you, and better than him is the one who suffices for you, and when he needs you, he excuses you [if you are unable to assist him].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of brothers is one who does not scrutinize his brothers.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of your brothers is the one whose anger at you increases in matters pertaining to the truth.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A friend is the better of the two resources.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A friend is the better of the two assets.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A friend is a better asset and is more lasting in fondness.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A friend is a person who is ‘you’ except that he is other than you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The truthful friend is one who advises you of your faults protects your dignity in your absence and gives you preference over himself.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The wise person is one who selects his friend carefully, for a man is gauged by his friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Friends are one soul in different bodies.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The [true] friend is he who forbids [one from] injustice and wrongdoing while helping [one] to perform good deeds and be righteous.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Keep the company of one whom you find cannot do without you, and if you do something bad to him he responds with good, as if he was the one at fault.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who has no brother (or brotherhood) has no goodness in him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who turns away from his brothers because of every [small] misdeed will have few friends.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who spoils [his relationship with] his friend has reduced his own number.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who accompanies evildoers will not be safe [from them].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Whoever is concerned about you, then he is your [true] friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One whose company is good will have many companions.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who sits in the company of the ignorant should be prepared for fruitless talk and gossip.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who does not attend to the needs of the one who shows friendship towards him has lost a friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who demands too much from his friend will sever his friendship.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who takes his [relationship with his] allies lightly will find the overrunning of his enemies to be heavy.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: It is through brotherhood for the sake of Allah that love becomes sincere.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: It is in times of tribulation that the protection of brethren is put to test.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: It is when power is lost that friend is distinguished from foe.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: I am amazed at the one who seeks more companions why does he not accompany the wise, pious scholars from whose character he can benefit and from whose knowledge he can get guidance and whose company is an embellishment for him!

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: In every companionship there is choice.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: In times of difficulty one comes to know who his [true] friend is.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: It is in times of [financial] difficulty that the value of a friend’s generosity becomes apparent.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Good companionship is something friends wish for.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to become negligent of your brother’s right [over you] while counting on your right over him, for indeed your brother has the same right over you that you have over him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to ignore the right of your brother while relying on the bond between you and him, for he whose right you overlook is not your brother.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best assets are reliable brothers.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The best of assets are a loyal brother and a righteous sibling.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The brother whose friendship is strongest is one who is most supportive of his brother [both] in times of ease and difficulty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The one who journeys in search of a righteous brother journeys the farthest.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Your true brother is one who forgives your mistake, fulfils your need, accepts your excuse, hides your [hidden] flaw, removes your apprehension and actualizes your hope.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not accompany the one who has lost his mind and do not seek good from one who is betrayed by his roots, for the one who is insane will harm you while he thinks he is helping you and the one who does not have [virtuous] roots will do evil to the one who does good to him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not accompany anyone but the intelligent and pious; and do not associate with anyone but the knowledgeable and righteous; and do not mention your secret to anyone but the trustworthy and loyal.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not accompany one who recalls your misdeeds and forgets your virtues and merits.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The companionship of the unintelligent is not enjoyable.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: None accompany the virtuous except those who are like them.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Those who sit in the company of the wicked are not safe from the calamities of tribulation.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Brothers are eliminators of grief and sorrow.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Obey your brother even if he disobeys you, and establish ties with him even if he shuns you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Keep yourself in the company of a virtuous and pious brother and you will remain safe, seek advice from him and you will benefit.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Love for the sake of Allah the one who struggles against you for the betterment of [your] religion and covers you with the mantle of certitude.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be courteous to your brothers and don’t expose them to the harshness of your tongue; and let your goodness flow forth for them.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Offer your advice to your friend, your assistance to your acquaintance, and to all the people, your cheerfulness.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be cautious of the company of one whose opinion is accepted but whose actions are evil, for surely a person is judged by the company he keeps.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to associate with an evil colleague, for his association will destroy you and his companionship will ruin you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not give preference to an ignoble person over a noble one.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Never associate with one who has no intelligence.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not associate with a fool, for he will embellish his actions for you and want you to become like him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not associate with those who love this world, for if you have less they will disregard you and if you have more they will envy you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not frequent the company of a wicked person, for if you are bestowed with a blessing, he will envy you and if a misfortune befalls you, he will abandon you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not acquire more ‘worldly’ brothers, for if you become incapable of fulfilling their wishes they turn into enemies; and their example is like the example of fire – a lot of it burns and a little of it benefits.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Take comfort for yourself in solitude rather than bad company.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be more confident of your intelligent foe than your ignorant friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Whenever the companionship prolongs, the [mutual] respect is affirmed.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: For everything there is a bane and the bane of a good person is bad company.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: For everything there is a vexation and the vexation of your lifetime is [being in] the company of an enemy.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who mingles with the wicked is not intelligent.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: There is nothing that brings one closer to good and keeps one safer from evil than keeping company with the righteous.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who accompanies the wise is respected.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to accompany the immoral, the wretched, and those who openly disobey the commandments of Allah.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be just as wary of sitting in the company of the ignorant, as you would be at ease in the company of the intelligent.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to remain in the company of the immoral, for surely evil clings to evil.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to be cheated by your friend or to be overcome by your foe.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to befriend a fool, for he will harm you while trying to benefit you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to befriend a miser, for he will hold back [from assisting you] when you are most in need of him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful not to accompany the wicked, for they consider it a favour upon you to keep you safe from themselves.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Your brother is your supporter in times of difficulty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: If you want to cut off ties with your brother [in faith] then leave some of your friendship for him, so that he may return to it someday if he so wishes.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Before choosing a friend, assess him and try hard to find out about him, otherwise you will be forced by necessity to associate with the wicked.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Accompanying a person [for some time] is sufficient to evaluate him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: [Even] if you have gained confidence and trust in your close friend, safeguard some of your affairs and conceal some of your secrets [from him], for it is possible that you may regret [revealing them] at some time [in the future].

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: As the bond of brotherhood strengthens, compliments become distasteful.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: When you [decide to] establish the bond of brotherhood, then honour the right of brotherhood.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: If you are certain of the affection of your brother then don’t be concerned [about what transpires] when you meet him or he meets you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who takes a brother after successfully evaluating him, his companionship will last longer and his bond will be more firmly established.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who does not investigate before he takes a brother will be misled to association with the depraved.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who takes a brother without evaluation will be forced by necessity to associate with the wicked.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The amity between those who are brothers for the sake of Allah endures because of its firm foundation.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: True brotherhood is an embellishment in times of ease and a provision in times of difficulty.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: The brother acquired for the sake of Allah is the nearest of relations – even closer than mothers and fathers.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Your brother for the sake of Allah is one who guides you towards rectitude, forbids you from corruption and assists you to improve your Hereafter.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Your true friend and brother is the one who protects you with his life, and prefers you over his wealth, his children and his spouse.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: It is only a few of the brothers who are fair.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: An evil companion is the worst of companions; and the disease of ignobility is a concealed disease.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Accompany the virtuous and you will become one of them; separate yourself from the evil people and you will be dissociated from them.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be sure to investigate before taking anyone as your brother, for assessment is the gauge that distinguishes the virtuous from the wicked.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who is courteous to his companion will gain his acceptance, and one who is harsh to him will drive him away and get separated from him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who is not pleased with his friend except when he prefers him over himself, will always be resentful.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One whose companionship is for the sake of Allah, his companionship is honourable and his friendship is upright.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Be careful of the one whose friendship is not for the sake of Allah, for his friendship is wicked and his company is doomed.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who does not assist you by [his] accompanying you, then his company is [actually] a burden on you, if [only] you knew.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who does not overlook the mistakes of his friend will die lonely.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who seeks a truly loyal friend, seeks that which cannot be found.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not accompany the one who lacks determination.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One whose friendship does not benefit you, his enmity will harm you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not excuse one who is insincere in his friendship with you.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One of the conditions of faith is [having] good companionship with one’s brothers.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Associating with the ignorant stems from lack of intelligence.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Never take your friend’s enemy as your friend, thereby making an enemy out of your friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: There is no life for one who is separated from those whom he loves.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: There is no good in a stingy (or suspicious) friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: A friend is not truly a friend unless he protects his brother in his absence, his misfortune and his death.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not break off ties with a friend, even if he is ungrateful.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not trust in a friend before testing him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not count one who does not support [you] with his wealth as a friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Do not rely on your friend until you have tested him, and be extremely cautious of your enemy.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who keeps good ties [and company] with his brothers makes their bond [with him] last longer.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who points out your faults to you and defends you in your absence, then he is your true friend, so protect him.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who has no friend has no provision.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One who calls you towards the Eternal Abode and assists you to work for it, then he is indeed a caring friend.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: One of the bad choices [that a person can make] is accompanying the wicked.

topic: The Brother, The Friend, The Associate and The Companion
text: Nothing establishes the boundaries of respect like companionship and neighbourhood.

topic: The soul and holding it to account-
text: Control the passion of your soul, the intensity of your rage, the power of your hand and the sharpness of your tongue, and guard against all these by delaying the initiation of any action and refraining from using force until your rage subsides and you recover your senses.

topic: The soul and holding it to account-
text: Take control over your vain desires and the distress of your soul, for indeed the distress of the soul lies in acting equitably in [both] the things which it loves and [in those which it] hates.

topic: The soul and holding it to account-
text: The one who keeps his soul steadfast against the temptations of worldly pleasures is a master [over it] and the one who neglects it is destroyed.

topic: The soul and holding it to account-
text: Self-restraint during times of anger saves one from situations that lead to harm.

topic: The soul and holding it to account-
text: Self-restraint during desire and fear is from the most excellent etiquette.

topic: The soul and holding it to account-
text: Every person who relies on himself [instead of Allah] is thrown [into destruction].

topic: The soul and holding it to account-
text: Whoever is deceived by his soul is delivered by it to places of destruction.

topic: This World
text: He who claims [to have] certitude in the eternal while he is still attached to the transient, has lied.

topic: This World
text: For every abundance [in this world] there is paucity.

topic: This World
text: For everything in this world there is expiry and annihilation.

topic: This World
text: For the one who finds delight in the pleasures of this world there is distress [and regret in the Hereafter].

topic: This World
text: Indeed, this world has unveiled the cloak [of its disloyalty] and notified you all equally.

topic: This World
text: Verily this world of yours is more lowly in my view than the [dry] bone of a pig in the hand of a leper.

topic: This World
text: It is not a [good] trade to consider this world to be a price for your soul and a substitute to that which is for you with Allah.

topic: This World
text: For love of this world, listeners turn a deaf ear to [words of] wisdom and hearts become blind to the light of insight.

topic: This World
text: Nobody gains any joy from this world but that it is followed by tears [of sorrow].

topic: This World
text: Allah, the Glorified, has not cleansed this world for His friends nor has He withheld it from His enemies.

topic: This World
text: Nobody gets the comforts of this world internally but that he has to face its hardships externally.7
flag_note: contains a stray character (digit 7) at the end of the sentence

topic: This World
text: One whose effort was for this world did not earn any recompense [for it] nor did he fulfil any obligation.

topic: This World
text: No person in this world is covered by the light rain of ease but that the heavy rain of distress pours upon him.

topic: This World
text: If the people of the world understood [the truth about it], this world would surely be ruined.

topic: This World
text: If this world was praiseworthy in front of Allah, He would have reserved it for His friends, but He turned their hearts away from it and expunged its desires from them.

topic: This World
text: If this world was to remain with one of you, it would not have reached the one in whose hands it is [now].

topic: This World
text: One who strives for this world is eluded by it.

topic: This World
text: One who holds back from this world is sought by it.

topic: This World
text: One who wrestles this world is knocked down by it.

topic: This World
text: One who disobeys this world is obeyed by it.

topic: This World
text: One who turns away from this world is approached by it.

topic: This World
text: One who knows [the reality of] this world, renounces it.

topic: This World
text: One who thinks little of this world, it comes to him humiliated.

topic: This World
text: One who is owned by this world falls down often.

topic: This World
text: One who is delighted by the embellishments of this world is owned by [its] deceptions.

topic: This World
text: One who buys his Hereafter with his world, gains both of them.

topic: This World
text: One who sells his Hereafter for his world loses both of them.

topic: This World
text: One who seeks less of this world gains more of that which keeps him secure [in the Hereafter].

topic: This World
text: One who seeks more of this world gains more of that which will ruin him.

topic: This World
text: One who builds his world destroys his place of return [in the Hereafter].

topic: This World
text: One who is deceived by this world is deceived by [his] aspirations.

topic: This World
text: One who is pleased with this world is eluded by the Hereafter.

topic: This World
text: One who is greedy for this world is destroyed.

topic: This World
text: One who is not content with the little [he has] of this world will not be satisfied with the much that he accumulates from it.

topic: This World
text: Who is more at a disadvantage than the one who sells the eternal [Hereafter] for the transient [world]?

topic: This World
text: Who is more at a loss than the one who exchanges the Hereafter for this world?

topic: This World
text: One who seeks from this world that which pleases him, his crime (and sinfulness) increases and his transgression prolongs.

topic: This World
text: One who relies on the deceptions of this world considers himself safe from its perils.

topic: This World
text: Whoever keeps back from seeking this world, it rises towards him.

topic: This World
text: One who exceeds the limits in seeking this world dies a pauper.

topic: This World
text: Whoever turns away from this world, it comes to him belittled.

topic: This World
text: One whose heart is attached to the love of this world catches three things from it: worry that never leaves him, greed that never abandons him and hopes that are never realized by him.

topic: This World
text: Whoever is attracted by the dazzle of this world, it blinds both his eyes.

topic: This World
text: One who desires the adornments of this world is eluded by the sought after eternal bliss [of the Hereafter].

topic: This World
text: One who has been overcome by this world is blind to that which is in front of him.

topic: This World
text: One who builds his world corrupts his religion and ruins his Hereafter.

topic: This World
text: One who loves [to acquire] the prestige of [both] this world and the Hereafter must detest prestige in this world.

topic: This World
text: One who humbles himself for the children of this world takes off the garment of piety.

topic: This World
text: One who fixes his gaze on the children of this world is blinded from the path of guidance.

topic: This World
text: One who seeks something from this world is eluded by something greater from the Hereafter than what he seeks [from this world].

topic: This World
text: Whoever seeks [the profits of] this world through the work of the Hereafter, it takes him further away from that which he seeks.

topic: This World
text: One who is glad to relinquish the bounties of this world [for the sake of the Hereafter] has certainly perfected his intellect.

topic: This World
text: Whoever gains possession of something of this world loses much more of the Hereafter than what he possesses [of this world].

topic: This World
text: One who knows [the reality of] this world is not saddened by that which befalls him [in it].

topic: This World
text: One who recognizes the deceptions of this world will not be deceived by its impossible dreams.

topic: This World
text: One who triumphs in this world becomes troubled and one whom it eludes gets distressed.

topic: This World
text: One in whose eyes this world is grand and in whose heart its position is great, prefers it over Allah and devotes himself to it and becomes a slave to it.

topic: This World
text: One who becomes infatuated with this world, it fills his heart with a sadness which keeps alternating in the black part of his heart, a distress that worries him and a grief that causes him pain, until its suffocation [of death] overtakes him and he is flung in the open while both the arteries of his heart are severed. It is easy for Allah to cause him to die and he becomes too far for his comrades to meet him (or to remain with him).

topic: This World
text: One who relies on this world is indeed wretched and deprived.

topic: This World
text: Whoever serves this world, it exploits him and whoever serves Allah, the Glorified, it (this world) serves him.

topic: This World
text: One whose concern [and effort] is for this world, his wretchedness and misery will be prolonged on the Day of Resurrection.

topic: This World
text: One who does not think about the bounties of his world becomes powerful.

topic: This World
text: One of the troubles of this world is the spoiling of union by separation and happiness by distress.

topic: This World
text: It is from the lowliness of this world in front Allah is that He is not disobeyed anywhere except in it.

topic: This World
text: From the [signs of the] contemptibleness of this world in the sight of Allah is that one does not gain that which is with Him except by abandoning it.

topic: This World
text: Nothing corrupts the faith like this world.

topic: This World
text: How will the offshoot remain after the root has gone?

topic: This World
text: This world of yours which endears itself to you is not better than the Hereafter which is made to appear ugly by your negative perception [of it].

topic: This World
text: That which you send forth from this world is for your own benefit and that which you leave behind from it is for your enemy.

topic: This World
text: That which [one] increases in this world, [he] diminishes in the Hereafter.

topic: This World
text: That which [one] diminishes in this world, [he] increases in the Hereafter.

topic: This World
text: Do not be overjoyed by that which you obtain in this world and do not despair with sadness for that which eludes you from it.

topic: This World
text: What is good in a house that falls down like demolished construction and in a lifetime that expires as [its] provisions get exhausted?

topic: This World
text: What is the matter with you? You are delighted with the little of this world that you obtain while you are not saddened by the abundance of the Hereafter that you are deprived of?!

topic: This World
text: This world has not deceived you, rather through it you have been deceived.

topic: This World
text: The transient world has not beguiled you, rather through it you have been beguiled.

topic: This World
text: What is [the matter] with you that which, if you acquire it [the wealth of this world], its improvement [and seeking something better than it] preoccupies you from enjoying it, and if you enjoy it, it spoils it [the enjoyment] for you with the victory of death over you.

topic: This World
text: The deceived person who gains success in this world through its smallest portion is not like the other person who is gains success in the Hereafter by exerting his greatest effort.8
flag_note: Contains a stray character (digit 8) at the end of the sentence.

topic: This World
text: How close this world is to departure, old age is to youth, and doubt is to uncertainty!

topic: This World
text: The bitterness of this world is the sweetness of the Hereafter.

topic: This World
text: One who accompanies this world is a target of calamities and mishaps.

topic: This World
text: The similitude of this world is like your shadow, if you stop it stops and if you seek it, it moves further away.

topic: This World
text: The similitude of this world is like the snake, its feel is soft but it has deadly venom in its fangs. The inexperienced and ignorant one reaches towards it while the wise and intelligent one is cautious of it.

topic: This World
text: The wares of this world are [like] broken orts that cause epidemics, therefore keep off the grazing land which is more beneficial to migrate from than to peacefully stay in, and that of it which suffices for subsistence in it is purer [for the soul] than its riches.

topic: This World
text: Destroyed is one who finds reassurance in this world and makes his religion its dower, so he turns towards it wherever it turns, having taken it to be his [only] concern and his deity.

topic: This World
text: Take it easy, for indeed the matter is near, the companionship is short and the sojourn is brief.

topic: This World
text: It (this world) is obstructive and obdurate, deviating and swaying, deceiving and ungrateful.

topic: This World
text: Those who are pleased with this world are destroyed on the Day of Resurrection and those who are disheartened by it are saved.

topic: This World
text: Do not desire anything that perishes and goes away, for this enough of a detriment.

topic: This World
text: Do not desire this world thereby losing your Hereafter.

topic: This World
text: Do not desire that which perishes, and take from the transient for the eternal.

topic: This World
text: Do not jostle for the bounties of this world, for indeed its bounties are trifling.

topic: This World
text: Do not give your religion as dower for this world, for indeed whoever gives his religion as dowry to this world, it brings to him wretchedness, pain, hardship and tribulation.

topic: This World
text: Do not sell the Hereafter for this world and do not exchange the eternal with the transient.

topic: This World
text: Do not let this world tempt you, and do not let your vain desires overpower you, and do not consider your stay in this world to be long, and do not let your hopes deceive you, for indeed hopes are not part of religion in any way.

topic: This World
text: Let not the greatest thing that you achieve in this world be the attainment of pleasures and the quelling of rage, rather let it be the enlivening of truth and the annihilation of falsehood.

topic: This World
text: Do not be tempted by good loans [and temporary pleasures], for the loans of this world are returned and you remain with that which you have accumulated of the forbidden.

topic: This World
text: Do not let the transient world deceive you with its false amusements, for indeed its amusement ceases while the vices which you have acquired remain with you.

topic: This World
text: Let not any of you pine the way a servant girl pines, for that which has departed from him of this world.

topic: This World
text: Do not solicit this world by the work of the Hereafter and do not prefer the transient over the eternal, for this is the trait of the hypocrites and the character of the apostates.

topic: This World
text: Never be deceived by the condition of the people of vanities [and what they enjoy of this world], for indeed it is an extended shadow [which lasts] until a fixed time.

topic: This World
text: The deceptions of this world do not excite the learned.

topic: This World
text: This world does not protect the one who seeks refuge in it.

topic: This World
text: People do not abandon anything from their religion for the sake of this world but that Allah opens for them that which is more harmful for them.

topic: This World
text: The delights of this world do not continue and its joys do not last, and there is no security from its afflictions.

topic: This World
text: It behoves the one who recognizes this world to renounce its pleasures and to turn away from it.

topic: This World
text: It behoves the one who recognizes the transient abode to work for the Eternal Abode.

topic: This World
text: It behoves the one who knows how fleeting this world is, to renounce its pleasures.

topic: This World
text: It behoves a person to seek a cure from the ailments of this world just like a sick person seeks treatment, and he should avoid its lusts and pleasures just as a sick person avoids certain foods.

topic: This World
text: Little of this world corrupts the faith.

topic: This World
text: Little of this world suffices and plenty of it destroys.

topic: This World
text: Little of this world is better than plenty of it, and that of it which suffices for subsistence in it is better than that which destroys.

topic: This World
text: Slaves of desire, cut them short! For indeed, the one who leans on this world gets nothing out of it but the grating sound of hardship.

topic: This World
text: One who works for this world makes a loss. afflictions. (‘a) (Ref: Sharhe Ghurar al-Ḥikam vol. 2 pg. 656). greatest effort is not like the other who is successful in the Hereafter by gaining its smallest portion. (Saying no. 380)
